_comment: Hand-written rules for B0 (roadmap P3 step 2) and, from P5, the Swift fallback: both read this file and must behave the same. Words are looked up in arabizi_lexicon.json (generated from training data) first; these letter rules are only for unknown words. Spellings follow docs/SPELLING.md.

clitics._comment: Small words written as their own Arabizi word but attached to the next word in Arabic (SPELLING.md 3).

clitic_before_latin._comment: Before a word kept in Latin (English), the Arabic part stays a separate word (SPELLING.md 4): el meeting -> ال meeting.

letters._comment: Longest match first. Digits inside words are letters (SPELLING.md 2). 2 is usually an etymological ق in Lebanese (2alle -> قلي); 8 is غ for many typists (8ali -> غالي).

vowels._short_word_comment: Final e in words of 4 letters or fewer is usually 'my' (bade -> بدي); longer ones are usually feminine (kbire -> كبيرة).

word_endings._comment: Checked before letter-by-letter conversion: the 'me / my' ending -ne/-ni is ني (sheyfne -> شايفني, kllfne -> كلفني).
